claims: Rory McIlroy's parents are Gerry and Rosie McIlroy.
Gerry and Rosie McIlroy are a working-class couple from Northern Ireland.
Gerry introduced Rory McIlroy to golf.
Gerry managed a bar and cleaned to fund Rory McIlroy's early training.
Gerry and Rosie McIlroy live in Northern Ireland.
Gerry worked as a bartender at Holywood Golf Club.
Rosie worked night shifts in a factory to fund Rory McIlroy's early tournaments.
Gerry and Rosie McIlroy did not take a family holiday for over a decade to afford Rory McIlroy's training.
Rory McIlroy has described his parents as his best friends.
Rory McIlroy has referred to his parents as a crucial part of his success.
Gerry and Rosie McIlroy were present at the 2026 Masters.
Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters back-to-back.
Gerry and Rosie McIlroy did not attend the 2025 Masters due to a superstition about interrupting his winning streak.
Rosie McIlroy grew up in Taghnevan.
Gerry McIlroy was in public housing outside Belfast
